failure_summary.description: Several answers missed the requested entity or level of specificity, such as returning an associated institution instead of the territory or a generic bird instead of the named species.

patch.reasoning: The recurring slot, scope, and concise-answer issues substantially overlap with edits already rejected in this epoch. The remaining alias and inflection mismatches are too narrow to justify repeating those proposals as a new general rule.
